title: MI Query Agent — the same acceptance banks on Opus 4.8, against LLM-off and Haiku
production_changes_made: NONE. No production file, bank, fixture, grader or prompt was modified. The model was selected purely through the existing MI_AGENT_LLM_MODEL environment override.

model_selection.requested: an Anthropic Opus model available to this account
model_selection.why_not_opus_5: claude-opus-5 is available to the account but the SHIPPED CODE CANNOT CALL IT. mi_agent/llm_query_parser.py sends temperature=0.0 unless the model matches _NO_SAMPLING_MODELS = ('opus-4-7','opus-4-8','opus-4.7','opus-4.8','sonnet-5','fable','mythos'). 'opus-5' is absent, so temperature is sent — and the installed anthropic SDK 1.x has REMOVED temperature from messages.create(), so the call raises TypeError before it reaches the API. Verified directly against _call_llm. Fixing that would require editing the repository, which this run forbids. claude-opus-4-8 is the newest Opus the shipped code can actually invoke unmodified.

correction_to_the_previous_haiku_run.finding: The earlier LLM-ON comparison ran on the repository default claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. That model is NOT in _NO_SAMPLING_MODELS, so every call sent temperature and raised TypeError inside _call_llm — both the cached and the uncached attempt. Verified directly: _call_llm raises for haiku and succeeds for opus-4-8.
correction_to_the_previous_haiku_run.consequence: That run made ZERO successful model calls. Its 55 'invocations' were attempts, counted at _invoke before the failure. Its results therefore measure 'LLM enabled but every call failing', not Haiku's judgement — a distinct configuration, and one that still moved 7 CFO questions and produced one WRONG answer.
correction_to_the_previous_haiku_run.restated: The Haiku column below should be read as 'LLM enabled, all calls failing', not as a Haiku capability measurement.

llm_engagement_opus.note: zero_cost_first keeps deterministically-resolved questions free of any model call, so these counts are genuine engagement.
